cases.title: Punished levitation descent moves a separated chain to the ball
cases.sourceTrace: A punished levitating Wizard stands two squares north of the uncarried ball in a wished pool. The chain is visibly at the midpoint (67,10), hero (67,9), ball/pool (67,11). Ring removal relocates hero to the ball; C also calls movobj to relocate the chain. JS skips that existing helper and leaves the midpoint chain glyph.

inputs.comment: Source-order correction for nontrivial trap.c:float_down chain relocation. Use the already C-observed valid Wizard options and inventory slots from the same seed: wish/equip levitation ring o, wish/read punishment scroll p at the original hero square, then wish pool while hero, ball, and chain remain co-located there. Move north twice on the observed clear rows so ball stays on pool and chain moves to midpoint; remove ring. Verify actual C positions and descent guard.
